revision_note: Revised after two rounds of PR review (Codex). Round 1: an earlier draft undercredited existing in-repo precedent (scripts/build_team_week_raw_v0_2024_candidate.py already has a real, validated 2024 candidate, not a fixture, proving qb_kneel/qb_spike/two_point_attempt/sack/penalty/aborted-play handling against actual nflverse pbp data); and the unknown_or_unclassified_alignment bucket must not be defined as a possible pistol superset, since a known shotgun==0 value cannot also be unknown without breaking the count-reconciliation rule. Round 2 (post f67c825): offensive_plays was ambiguous between team_week_raw_v0's two distinct denominators (kneel/spike-inclusive offensivePlays vs pass/run-only competitivePlays) which made the reconciliation identity mathematically impossible whenever a team-season had a kneel/spike; and the qb_scramble field-audit note conflated denominator inclusion (fine via play_type) with the pass/run split for *_pass_rate/*_run_rate (must use qb_dropback per team_week_raw_v0 precedent, not play_type, or scrambles get silently reclassified as rush).

under_center_derivation_decision.reason: shotgun==0 cannot be safely relabeled under_center because pistol-formation handling in the source is unverified in this session, and there is no dedicated pistol field in the documented schema

bucket_definitions_corrected.shotgun_plays: shotgun == 1 on a qualifying offensive play
bucket_definitions_corrected.non_shotgun_plays: shotgun == 0 on a qualifying offensive play, full stop -- NOT a possible-pistol-superset; if the source encodes pistol as shotgun==0, those snaps have a known non-null value and belong here by construction, not in the unknown bucket. The caveat is about what the label honestly means to a downstream reader (non_shotgun may silently include pistol formations), not about bucket membership.
bucket_definitions_corrected.unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays: qualifying offensive plays where shotgun itself is null/missing in the source. Nothing else belongs here -- this is not a home for pistol ambiguity about a value the source did provide.

under_center_derivation_decision.rule: missing/null shotgun values fall into unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays; a known shotgun==0 value always falls into non_shotgun_plays regardless of whether it might be a pistol snap
under_center_derivation_decision.reconciliation_identity: shotgun_plays + non_shotgun_plays + unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays == offensive_plays, exactly, using only the observed shotgun field value
under_center_derivation_decision.under_center_label_unlocked_only_after: a live nflreadpy.load_pbp() pull confirms pistol-snap treatment (e.g. negligible volume, or a way to separate it out)

denominator_rules.base_filter_recommended: categorical play_type membership (team_week_raw_v0 pattern: play_type in {pass, run} for competitive plays; play_type in {pass, run, qb_kneel, qb_spike} for raw offensive-play counting), not the pass/rush-flag-only team_state pattern
denominator_rules.base_filter_older_weaker_pattern: posteam not null AND (pass==1 OR rush==1 OR play_type in [pass, run]) -- tiber_team_state_v0_1's pattern; not proven against real data for no-play exclusion the way the team_week_raw_v0 pattern is
exclusions_already_proven_via_real_2024_: no-play rows (categorical play_type exclusion, not reliance on pass/rush flags)
penalty-only (no-snap) rows; penalty on an otherwise-recorded play does not remove that play
qb_kneel (play_type == qb_kneel, excluded from rate/efficiency fields)
qb_spike (play_type == qb_spike, same treatment as qb_kneel)
two_point_attempt == true (excluded from the offensive-play denominator entirely, not just 'primary' denominator)
aborted_play (policy locked; exact field-level detection mechanism unconfirmed)
not_requiring_special_handling_at_v0: qb_scramble for denominator INCLUSION only (correctly counted via categorical play_type filter regardless of the exact scramble-flag column name, which remains GATED upstream) -- see pass_run_split_correction below for why this does NOT extend to the pass/run split

two_tier_denominator_correction.finding: team_week_raw_v0 keeps TWO separate denominators: is_offensive_play (kneel/spike included, two_point excluded) and is_competitive_play (pass/run only, two_point excluded, used for passRate/rushRate/epaPerPlay). An earlier draft left formation_summary_v0's offensive_plays ambiguous between the two, which makes shotgun_plays + non_shotgun_plays + unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays == offensive_plays mathematically impossible for any team-season with a kneel or spike, since those plays have no alignment-tendency bucket to belong to.
two_tier_denominator_correction.resolution: offensive_plays in formation_summary_v0 means ONLY the competitive-play/formation-eligible count (team_week_raw_v0's competitivePlays-equivalent): pass/run only, with kneels, spikes, two-point attempts, no-plays, penalty-only rows, aborted plays, and special teams excluded entirely, not just from rates. This is the sole denominator for the reconciliation identity.
two_tier_denominator_correction.optional_field: raw_offensive_plays may be carried separately (kneel/spike-inclusive, team_week_raw_v0's offensivePlays-equivalent) for cross-artifact comparison, but is never used as an alignment-rate denominator and never appears in the reconciliation identity.

pass_run_split_correction.finding: team_week_raw_v0's aggregate_game classifies pass vs rush using the qb_dropback indicator, not play_type -- a scramble has play_type=='run' but qb_dropback==1, so team_week_raw_v0 counts it as a PASS play for passRate/passEpaPerPlay. An earlier draft's qb_scramble note ('falls correctly under the rush bucket via play_type') was true only for denominator inclusion, not for the pass/run split, and would have silently forked formation_summary_v0's shotgun_pass_rate/shotgun_run_rate/non_shotgun_pass_rate/non_shotgun_run_rate from the exact precedent this spec tells implementers to reuse.
pass_run_split_correction.resolution: the pass/run split within each alignment bucket must use the same verified dropback indicator (qb_dropback) team_week_raw_v0 uses, not play_type. play_type remains correct for denominator inclusion (two_tier_denominator_correction) and for the shotgun/non_shotgun/unknown alignment split itself (alignment is orthogonal to dropback-vs-scramble) -- only the pass-vs-run split changes.
pass_run_split_correction.fail_closed_rule: if qb_dropback is null/unavailable for one or more formation-eligible plays in a team-season, null-block the affected *_pass_rate/*_run_rate fields for that row, mirroring team_week_raw_v0's dropbackSplitBlocked/dropbackNullRows pattern exactly, rather than guessing an attribution from play_type.

success_rate_conflict_finding.finding: src/team_state/definitions.py and compute.py already define a TIBER-specific success rule (>=40% ydstogo on 1st down, >=60% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd/4th), independent of any native nflverse success column (which the real 2024 team_week_raw_v0 candidate build also references via row.get('success'))
success_rate_conflict_finding.risk: silently adopting nflverse's own success field under the same field name would create two divergent 'success' definitions across sibling TIBER-Data artifacts
success_rate_conflict_finding.recommendation: reuse the existing TIBER team_state success rule verbatim for formation_summary_v0; if nflverse's native field is used instead, name it distinctly (e.g. epa_success_rate vs distance_success_rate)

justification: formation_lens_v0 (Teamstate) is a season-level explanation surface, does not need weekly granularity
team_week multiplies sample-size risk 18x before alignment ambiguity (shotgun/pistol) is resolved
recommended_grain.team_week_deferred_until: team_season coverage and alignment ambiguity are resolved and sample-size/warning behavior is proven reliable

envelope.hard_rule: governance/provenance status is never inferred from file path, file name, branch name, or consumer intent

fields: shotgun_pass_rate (pass/run split MUST use qb_dropback, not play_type -- see pass_run_split_correction)
raw_offensive_plays (optional; kneel/spike-inclusive; never used as a rate denominator or in the reconciliation identity)
two_point_plays (excluded from offensive_plays entirely, not just from rates)
shotgun_success_rate (optional, gated, must use TIBER team_state success definition)
row_shape.null_vs_zero: optional efficiency fields remain absent/null/insufficient_data until EPA/success definitions are source-backed and sample thresholds are met

sample_size_thresholds.small_sample_behavior: suppress the efficiency/prose field entirely, do not merely attach a warning; rate/count fields may still be emitted with a sample_notes flag
sample_size_thresholds.league_relative_labels_in_v0: not allowed; no league-baseline artifact exists yet in this repo; deferred

fail_closed_rules: required source fields unavailable at build time -> fail closed
unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays exceeding 10% of offensive_plays for a row requires an explicit high-uncertainty flag
denominator rule must be applied consistently and stated in artifact metadata
offensive_plays populated from the kneel/spike-inclusive raw count instead of the formation-eligible count is a hard validation failure (two_tier_denominator_correction)
emitting non_shotgun under the label under_center is a hard validation failure
*_pass_rate/*_run_rate derived from play_type instead of the verified dropback indicator is a hard validation failure (pass_run_split_correction)
a team-season with a null/unavailable dropback indicator on any formation-eligible play must null-block *_pass_rate/*_run_rate for that row, not guess
missing source snapshot/version, sourceRefs, or governance/provenance markers fails validation
sample-size thresholds must be declared and enforced
shotgun_plays + non_shotgun_plays + unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays must equal offensive_plays exactly, using the formation-eligible count, never the kneel/spike-inclusive raw count
success field must disclose which definition (TIBER team_state rule vs nflverse native) was used

relationship_to_lanes.team_week_raw_v0: closest real-data precedent; already has a validated 2024 candidate solving no-play/kneel/spike/penalty/sack/scramble/aborted-play/two-point/special-teams exclusion via categorical play_type membership; formation_summary_v0 should reuse this pattern and cite this precedent rather than re-deriving denominator policy
relationship_to_lanes.tiber_team_state_v0_1: sibling, not a dependency; its pass/rush-flag-only pattern is the weaker of the two in-repo patterns for no-play exclusion; must not fork the success-rate definition silently
relationship_to_lanes.formation_lens_v0_teamstate: downstream consumer, not started here; remains blocked from real-data interpretation until this artifact exists and passes a separate consumption approval
relationship_to_lanes.player_season_coverage_v0: shape/vocabulary precedent only (truth_status vocabulary, envelope shape); no code/data dependency
relationship_to_lanes.fantasy_forecast: out of scope entirely; not referenced by any field/grain/envelope choice here
